generation_conditioning: Observed t0 RGB/masks/depth/intrinsics, t0-only synthetic clean plate and the frozen MolmoMotion forecast; no ground-truth future RGB/poses.
episode_selection: Inherited episode 10, t0 frame 63. Original scene metadata explicitly records future screening during the earlier episode/t0 selection, before model inputs were formed.
group_selection: User explicitly selected the saved group_00 arc shown in the left comparison column; group_01/02 are retained as differing forecasts.
legacy_config_field: causal_MolmoMotion_benchmark=true describes the current run's conditioning. It does not establish blind episode selection or a representative dataset benchmark.
evaluation_future: Permitted only after all generation, for the physical 2s variant. Stretched variants have no corresponding real 6s reference in this experiment.
interpretation: One previously selected scene and one seed. Compare generation with its forecast; do not claim dataset-wide robot accuracy or statistical model improvement.
